title: renders are refused by the launch args of the live :8188 instance while the 4090 has room (22.2GiB free vs ask 21GiB)
evidence: port 8188 answering, free=22.2GiB vs ask 21GiB (so free VRAM is NOT the cause), claim=idle; the :8188 instance (pid 553489, owner foreign, holder operator) was launched WITHOUT --reserve-vram, so `ensure` refuses on the ARGS before it ever asks the scheduler for a claim — this refusal is about the launch line, not about how much VRAM is free (see COMFY_RESERVE_VRAM). Response: the OPERATOR's interactive session -- a human is using the shared install; yield the window, do not touch/restart/re-flag it (a running process's args are not ours to change); the harness yields the window rather than submitting to an unflagged instance, so renders stay blocked until that instance exits or is relaunched with --reserve-vram. Nothing here is ours to restart.
